name: gomrok/gomrok
description: Gomrok — standalone multi-client payment orchestration service

scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the integration test suite (needs MySQL)
scripts-descriptions.rollback: Roll back the last database migration
scripts-descriptions.rollback:all: Roll back every migration (down to an empty schema)
scripts-descriptions.db:reset: Roll everything back, re-migrate, re-seed (needs MySQL)
scripts-descriptions.db:fresh: Roll everything back and re-migrate, no seed (needs MySQL)
scripts-descriptions.client:create: Create a client + first API key (--slug --name --currency ...)
scripts-descriptions.client:issue-key: Issue another API key for a client (--client=<slug|id>)
scripts-descriptions.client:list: List clients with their active key counts
scripts-descriptions.provider-group:configure: Set a group's countries / purchase types / methods (--client --group --country ... --purchase-type ...)
scripts-descriptions.provider-group:set-accounts: Set a group's ordered provider-account list (--client --group --account ...)
scripts-descriptions.package:create: Add a package to a client's catalogue (--client --code --name [--description])
scripts-descriptions.package:update: Edit a package's name / description / status (--client --package ...)
scripts-descriptions.package:set-availability: Set a package's country / currency / method / provider availability (--client --package ...)
scripts-descriptions.package:set-capabilities: Set a package's global purchase-type set (--client --package --capability=<type> ...)
scripts-descriptions.package:set-country-capabilities: Set a package's per-country purchase-type overrides (--client --package --override=CC:type ...)
scripts-descriptions.package:link-provider: Link a package to a provider account on the provider side (--client --package --account ...)
scripts-descriptions.package:list: List a client's packages with availability + purchase-type counts (--client=<slug|id>)
scripts-descriptions.pricing:set-group-package: Set a package's price/display in a pricing group (--client --group --package --status ...)
scripts-descriptions.pricing:delete-rule: Delete a price rule by id (--client --rule=<id>)
scripts-descriptions.pricing:list-rules: List a package's price rules, most specific first (--client --package)
scripts-descriptions.pricing:create-list: Create an A/B price list in a pricing group (--client --group --name [--factor])
scripts-descriptions.pricing:set-list-status: Enable or disable an A/B price list (--client --list=<id> --enable|--disable)
scripts-descriptions.pricing:set-list-factor: Change a non-control price list's multiplier (--client --list=<id> --factor)
scripts-descriptions.pricing:set-list-price: Pin an exact package price on an A/B list (--client --list=<id> --package --amount-minor --currency)
scripts-descriptions.pricing:list-lists: List a pricing group's A/B price lists (--client --group)
scripts-descriptions.ci: Local CI: code style, static analysis, unit tests (no infrastructure)
scripts-descriptions.ci:full: ci plus the integration suite (needs MySQL: docker compose up -d mysql)
